newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian police seize top drug mobster.
newsitem.headline: Colombian police seize top drug mobster.

text.p: Police captured the leader of the main drug mob in Colombia's eastern plains region on Thursday, an official said.
Col. Leonardo Gallego, head of the anti-narcotics police, said Franklin Ramirez, head of the so-called Plains Cartel, was seized in the town of Villavicencio, about 45 miles (70 km) east of Bogota.

"This is an important arrest because Ramirez is a drug trafficker who administers and controls jungle drug labs. He is behind the production of a high volume of cocaine and ships considerable quantities abroad," Gallego said.
He said Ramirez controlled scores of clandestine cocaine laboratories in the jungle-covered eastern province of Guaviare, one of Colombia's main coca leaf-growing areas.
Last year Colombian police destroyed more than 860 illicit cocaine and heroin-manufacturing plants across the country.

Gallego told reporters Ramirez was one of a new breed of smaller drug barons who were becoming increasingly important since the virtual break-up of the Cali and Medellin drug cartels, decimated by a wave of arrests and killings.
